title: Cross-validate: presence encoding parity
description: Verify Python/Rust/Zephyr produce identical presence CBOR
close_reason: Cross-validation complete for Python/Rust. Added test_presence_vectors.py (Python) and presence_vectors.rs (Rust) that validate encoding against test/vectors/presence_cbor.json. Both produce identical CBOR bytes. Zephyr presence code does not exist yet (zephyr dir is symlink to external repo) - Zephyr validation deferred until implementation exists.
